## Overview

Edge a drawer is anchored to. `left`/`right`/`top`/`bottom` are physical and never mirror.
`inline-start`/`inline-end` follow the writing direction: in LTR `inline-start` is `left`, in
RTL it is `right` (and vice versa for `inline-end`).

- **Kind:** Type alias
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/drawer/drawer.types.ts:8](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/drawer/drawer.types.ts#L8)

## Definition

type DrawerSide = 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom' | 'inline-start' | 'inline-end';
